visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with short dark hair, wearing a blue and white striped pajama shirt over a black t-shirt, sits on a light wooden floor. He is focused on a yellow and white cylindrical container of milk tablets, picking them out with his fingers. An adult woman sits in the background, partially visible, looking at her phone. (2) The boy holds up a single white tablet toward the camera lens, offering it. He has large expressive eyes and a curious facial expression. A 3M measuring tape and other household items are scattered on the floor around him. (3) The scene shifts to the boy interacting with his mother, who is now sitting on the floor facing him. He offers her a tablet, but she playfully pulls away or refuses. The room is warmly lit with indoor lamps, and a dark window with city lights is visible in the background. (4) A montage sequence follows where the boy repeatedly tries to give tablets to the mother. She responds with exaggerated 'No' head shakes and facial expressions. The boy displays a range of reactions from confusion to persistent smiling. (5) In the final phase, the boy aggressively pours multiple tablets into a hand extended toward him. The mother and a background woman laugh at his enthusiastic 'salesmanship.' The boy has a bright, excited smile.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched toddler voice speaking excitedly in Mandarin. Playful, mid-tempo electronic BGM with a bouncy synth melody starts. Room tone is minimal. (2) Mother's voice enters with a warm, playful tone. A sharp 'boing' cartoon sound effect triggers as a rejection subtitle appears. The BGM remains consistent with a 4/4 beat. (3) A sequence of rhythmic 'No' responses from the mother. Each utterance is punctuated by a high-frequency digital impact SFX. The child’s pitch fluctuates as he persists. (4) Sound of tablets rattling in a plastic container occurs simultaneously with rapid-fire Mandarin dialogue. (5) Loud, collective laughter from two female voices. The child lets out a high-pitched exclamation. BGM swells slightly for the outro with a bright melodic finish.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Role Reversal Repetition -> Humorous Climax
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To entertain the audience by showcasing a humorous and cute role-reversal interaction between a mother and her young son, where the mother mimics the child's frequent refusal of things by saying 'No' to his offers of snacks.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The milk tablets are shown as a prop for a family joke rather than a promoted product; no specific links or brand-focused CTAs are present.
